# Version 4.158.0
> **Skia m158 and HarfBuzz 15** · [NuGet (prerelease)](https://www.nuget.org/packages/SkiaSharp/4.158.0-preview.2.26560.5)

> **API changes** · [SkiaSharp API diff](4.158.0/index.md) · [HarfBuzzSharp API diff](harfbuzzsharp/15.0.0/index.md)

## Highlights

SkiaSharp 4.158.0 previews Skia m158 alongside HarfBuzz 15.0.0 and expanded script constants. Preview 2 adds GPU correctness fixes for reflected hairlines, text-atlas selection, Graphite clipping and affected Mali Vulkan device-loss paths. SkiaSharp's managed API surface remains unchanged; HarfBuzzSharp gains 30 named Script fields.

## Breaking Changes

*None in this preview line.*

## Engine

- **Skia milestone 158** — Updates the bundled rendering engine to Skia m158 without changing SkiaSharp's managed APIs or C bridge declarations. ([#5634](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/5634))
- **HarfBuzz 15.0.0** — Updates the bundled HarfBuzz engine and HarfBuzzSharp packages to 15.0.0. This is a native engine upgrade, unlike Preview 1's 14.4.0.300 package revision, which retained HarfBuzz 14.4.0. ([#5554](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/5554), [#5634](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/5634))

## API Surface

- **Thirty additional named scripts** — HarfBuzzSharp.Script adds Jurchen, ProtoCuneiform, Seal and 27 previously omitted constants. Existing fields and values, parsing, numeric conversions and horizontal-direction lookup remain intact. ([#5554](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/5554))

## Bug Fixes

- **Hairline and text rendering** — Corrects zero-length square-capped hairline sizing under reflected transforms and rounds Ganesh text-atlas indices before sampler selection to avoid choosing the wrong atlas. ([#5669](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/5669))
- **GPU clipping and device-loss handling** — Bounds Graphite clip recording per render pass, rejecting and logging draws whose clips cannot fit a fresh pass instead of overflowing. Adds a delay only on affected device-loss paths for ARM proprietary Vulkan drivers from version 42 up to, but not including, 56. ([#5669](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/5669))

## HarfBuzzSharp 15.0.0

Updates the bundled engine and HarfBuzzSharp packages to 15.0.0 and adds 30 named Script fields, including Jurchen, ProtoCuneiform and Seal. Existing Script fields and values remain unchanged, as do parsing, numeric conversions and horizontal-direction lookup.

## Preview 2 (November 9, 2026)

Preview 2 adds HarfBuzz 15.0.0 and 30 HarfBuzzSharp.Script constants. It also corrects reflected hairlines, text-atlas selection and Graphite clip recording, and adds a targeted Mali Vulkan device-loss workaround.

[Full changelog](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/compare/v4.158.0-preview.1.26556.2...v4.158.0-preview.2.26560.5)

## Preview 1 (November 6, 2026)

Preview 1 introduces Skia m158 without changing SkiaSharp's managed API surface. HarfBuzzSharp moves to package revision 14.4.0.300 while its native engine remains at 14.4.0.

[Full changelog](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/compare/v4.157.0-rc.1.26560.6...v4.158.0-preview.1.26556.2)
